$comment: The six-TLD rainbow. NAMES ONLY, AND THAT IS THE POINT — unlike gems.json
and auras.json, this file has no sibling hexes in css/tokens.css to be
joined against, because none have ever been assigned. The corpus fixes the
six COLOURS as words (brand-identity-as-architecture §6.4 and §10.1,
resolved 2026-06-30); no file in the estate fixes a value.
⛔ DO NOT PIN HEXES HERE TO MAKE THE PAGE PRETTIER. Nothing consumes them:
the four sites that vendor this layer are sayyourname, playsey, seysays and
333.eco, and not one of them is a heartbank.{TLD}. Six tokens would ship
byte-identical into all four behind brand.lock, buy nothing, and invite
exactly the misuse the gem warning already forbids. Pin them when the first
heartbank.{TLD} surface actually needs them, and measure contrast then —
the gem palette's own hexes were proposed in a working document and lived
there for weeks before they were ratified into tokens.css.
⚠️ THIS IS A DOMAIN MAP. A colour here means a DOMAIN's product class and
its heart-idiom — not a medium (gems.json) and not a rate (auras.json).
The six hues are one-for-one with the six saturated gems, which is exactly
why they are rendered on a different CARRIER on the guidelines page: gems
are chips, these are marks. Same hue, different object, no fusion.
`cssNamed` below is the CSS keyword that spells the doctrine's word. It is
a RENDERING OF THE NAME, never a pinned value — that is why it is a
keyword and not a hex, and why it is allowed to look untuned beside the
measured gems.
order: Spectrum order, red through violet. The assignments were made per-domain, one at a time, by heart-idiom — that they compose a complete rainbow was found afterwards, and showing them out of spectrum order would hide the only property that makes the allusion earned.
scope: HeartBank® — one body of five. This palette is body-scoped in a way the gems and the aura ramp are not; it is documented here because the brand layer is where the three palettes are told apart, not because the institution's colour system is one body's domain map.

tlds.idiom: the universal human heart; .us reads as "us" = humanity; PoH = proof of humanity

tlds.productClass: Thank Your Future Kindness℠ — the pledge surface
tlds.idiom: warmth and forward-looking hope; .me is personal and future-facing

tlds.productClass: Franchise arm — B-Affiliate directory; the CEO surface
tlds.idiom: commerce, growth, the greenback, local-economy revival

tlds.productClass: Tree of Humanity — institutional output; the Phase-2 global commons
tlds.idiom: water, for watering the Tree of Humanity; trust and the worldwide net

tlds.productClass: Root = B-Store; Chronicle — adult-scale time economy
tlds.idiom: the Purple Heart — honour and sacrifice; finite time given

reserved.pink: Held out of the six for B-Dating and romantic contexts — the same reservation the gems and the aura ramp keep. Three palettes, one reservation.
